_schema.description: Seat-level models, one entry per district per model: MRP polls (by hand), Australian Election Forecasts (aeforecasts.com, refreshed by scripts/refresh.py every run) and RedBridge's seat model (statewide totals, by hand; refresh.py warns when RedBridge's site shows a newer Victorian release). null = not published.

fields.models: [{id, source, kind (mrp | forecast | projection), name, credit, client, fieldwork, sample_size, published, model_date (forecast: when the model was run) or published_date (YYYY-MM-DD), label, source_url, data_url, notes; forecasts also fp_percentiles and expected_seats {bloc: sum of win probabilities}; projections also inputs {poll, primary} and totals {bloc: seats, toss_up}, toss_ups ([district ids] or null if not published)}]
fields.district: id of the district in districts.json
fields.model: id of the model in models
fields.winner: Predicted winner party code (ALP, LIB, NAT, LNP, GRN, ONP, IND, OTH) or null if not published
fields.winner_name: Forecasts: the winning candidate's name as the model gives it
fields.runner_up: Predicted runner-up party code or null
fields.win_probability: Predicted probability (0-100) the winner takes the seat, or null if not published
fields.candidates: Forecasts: [{name, party, win_probability (0-100), fp [low, central, high] first-preference %}], fp at the model's fp_percentiles
fields.others: Forecasts: [{label, party, win_probability, fp}] for outcomes without a named candidate (others, an emerging independent or party)
fields.two_cp: Forecasts: [{parties [A, B], probability (0-100) of that final pairing, share [low, central, high] of A's 2CP %}]

models.name: YouGov MRP
models.notes: Projected winner, runner-up and winner's 2CP share from the report's per-seat table. No win probabilities published. Fieldwork predates the July 2026 Labor leadership change.

models.name: DemosAU MRP
models.notes: No Victorian seat-level DemosAU MRP found as of 30 Oct 2026 (DemosAU's October MRP was federal; its September Victorian release was a seat projection from a statewide poll, not per-seat). Entries left blank.

models.name: RedBridge seat model
models.notes: RedBridge's seat model run on the latest Newspoll's statewide primaries, posted on LinkedIn by RedBridge's Kosmos Samaras (date read from the post's id). Statewide totals only: no per-seat ratings, and the six toss-up seats aren't recorded here (LinkedIn can't be read by scripts). Add them to toss_ups by hand if needed.

models.name: Australian Election Forecasts
models.label: Improve ON seat distribution + fix LNP/NAT seat baselines
models.notes: Win probabilities and first-preference ranges per candidate, from the model's simulations. fp and share are [5th percentile, median, 95th percentile]; two_cp lists the final pairings with at least 1% chance, share being the first party's 2CP %. 'An emerging independent/party' is the model's allowance for a strong candidate not yet named.
